title: Quotient of a module by a submodule
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M$ an $R$-module and $N\subseteq M$ an $R$-submodule. The *quotient module* $M/N$ is the set of cosets $m+N=\{m+n:n\in N\}$, $m\in M$, with $(m+N)+(m'+N)=(m+m')+N$ and $r(m+N)=rm+N$; it is an $R$-module, and the *quotient map* $q:M\to M/N$, $m\mapsto m+N$ (also written $m\bmod N$), is a surjective $R$-linear map with kernel $N$. In particular, for submodules $N\subseteq P$ of $M$, $P/N$ is the quotient of the module $P$ by its submodule $N$.
